scope: One explicit claim_offset_instruction posts receivable -amount and payable -amount to one typed claim_account.z_history root at one effective timestamp; net delta is zero.
Amount is positive and exact at the account currency precision. Existing shared claim capacity guards reject overdraw of either measure atomically.
Receivable and payable capacity use complete-timestamp instant_min semantics so same-time record ID order has no economic meaning; recognized_credit remains on its existing strict-prefix guard.

The single claim_account reference carries the shared entity, opponent and currency dimensions. Cross-account offsets, authorization rules and statutory or eligibility interpretations are out of scope.
The offset has no treasury, cash-allocation, or stock membership.

mechanism.instruction: One explicit positive amount, one typed REJECT/READONLY claim_account reference, one effective_at, one required tree membership with both receivable and payable deltas and net 0.
mechanism.capacity: claim_account validation rejects when complete-timestamp receivable.instant_min or payable.instant_min falls below zero; both measures are validated together with the root update.
mechanism.lifecycle: The instruction's stable record ID owns its one tree membership; updates rekey or replace that membership atomically, deletion prunes it, and the typed account reference rejects account deletion while the instruction exists.

checks: Opening R6 and P18 followed by explicit offset 6 at a later timestamp leaves receivable 0, payable 12, and unchanged net; treasury is unchanged.

Moving the offset before both openings rejects and restores the complete source, instruction, root and treasury snapshot; moving it to the payable opening timestamp succeeds and independently reconstructs R0/P12/net unchanged.

Zero, negative and USD currency-inexact amount 1.001 reject. Independent fixtures reject receivable overdraw and payable overdraw. An amount edit from 6 to 7 rejects with the full snapshot unchanged; a valid edit to 5 updates both measures.

Same-time payable R/P source rows inserted in reverse order plus offset 6 yield R0/P12; a second same-time offset of 1 rejects, proving complete-time overdraw protection rather than a record-ID prefix result.
Independent row reconstruction checks receivable, payable and net totals; the offset produces no treasury movement.
